searchRounds: Vaughan Hall marine vertebrate collection visit

sources.finding: Official visit instructions locate fish collection room 224 on the second floor southeast corner. They describe ground-floor doors next to a lecture hall, but do not give a numbered target-room polygon. No requested room is located by this alone.
Building inventory identifies the present Vaughan Hall as a 1999 building, distinct from the older small Vaughan Hall in a 2000 demolition application. Inventory is not an interior plan.
Official guide corroborates reservable Vaughan rooms 100,147,300,328,348. This is the same identity source recorded previously, not new geometry.

limitations: Do not use unrelated Vaughan Hall in Burbank or the demolished former Scripps Vaughan building.
New wayfinding is for room224, not one of the requested four classrooms; no campus point or room polygon is inferred.
